text:
laura.p: legal pinged about SIEM export controls and asked for a concrete migration plan for retention + JIT raw access. putting a short proposal here for feedback. :lock:

rafael: TLDR suggestion: classify at ingest, create two long-term views (redacted, pseudonymized), keep raw in short-lived snapshot buckets, and require an OPA-approved JIT unwrap that issues an ephemeral cert from Vault.

nina_ops: can you call out retention numbers? ops needs bucket lifecycle rules to automate deletes.

laura.p: proposed retention by sensitivity:
- PII (emails, ssn): redacted export = 60d, pseudonymized index = 270d, raw snapshot = 30d (incident) / 730d (legal hold only)
- Auth events (login/token): redacted export = 90d, full index = 365d, raw snapshot = 30d
- Telemetry (metrics/traces): export = 180d, index = 540d, raw snapshot = none unless forensic request
- Debug (stack traces): export masked = 30d, index = 90d, raw snapshot = 14d
These numbers bias shorter export windows vs current baseline to minimize exposure.

tom.oncall: sounds good. For oncall access: proposal is to keep oncall group mapped to read-only masked views. Add a second entitlement `siem:raw_unwrap` that is not in default oncall group. Access flow: request -> OPA policy eval -> ticket created -> sec approver -> Vault issues short-lived PKCS12/SSH cert or DEK unwrap token (TTL 20m).

rafael: Implementation detail: use envelope encryption (DEK per tenant) stored encrypted by global CMK. On unwrap we call KMS:Decrypt(DEK_ciphertext) but only from our unwrap service which will only run with ephemeral identity minted by Vault after approval. Avoid per-tenant CMKs unless tenant explicitly requests. For customers who require CP-KMS, offer per-tenant CMK enrollment.

nina_ops: we should add a fallback for partner exports: partners only ever get filtered streams. For partners with contractual raw access we require customer-provided keys (SSE-C) or explicit legal work.

laura.p: RBAC change list (short):
1) add entitlement `siem:raw_unwrap_request` (grantable only via approval workflow)
2) add ephemeral service account role `siem:unwrap_executor` created by infra when ticket open
3) map OIDC groups -> OPA policy (eval includes requester group, incident flag, ticket id, justification)
4) audit-only deny for test mode (send events but block unwrap until policy passes)

tom.oncall: Audit schema proposal (must be logged to immutable topic):
```
{ "event_type":"siem.unwrap", "time":"ISO8601", "requester":"laura.p", "requester_id":"U123", "approver":"sec_jane", "approver_id":"U987", "tenant":"T-456", "decryption_key_id":"dek-2026-05-01", "duration_minutes":"20", "reason":"incident triage #3456", "hash_of_rows":"sha256:..." }
```
Make sure the audit contains a cryptographic hash of the rows returned so downstream forensics can verify integrity.

rafael: Ops knobs: bucket lifecycle policies, snapshot size limits (50GB by default), automated scrubbing job that re-checks pseudonymization, and a daily report of unwrap events. We'll need infra to implement policy-enforced rate limits per team.

nina_ops: quick sample of request curl for the JIT flow (ops api):
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/siem/unwrap -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"T-456","reason":"inc-3456 triage","rows_hash":"sha256:...","ttl":20}'
```
Response returns ticket id. Approver UI calls vault/approve and vault mints ephemeral credential bound to ticket id.

laura.p: QA and tests:
- policy unit tests for OPA rules
- integration test for Vault issuance + KMS decrypt call (mock KMS in CI)
- audit replay test: replay audit event -> verify hash matches snapshot digest

sec-bot: Added checklist item: validate ticket id and digest before allowing unwrap. Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-unwrap (2026-03-10).

tom.oncall: next steps: I'll open a short RFC with the flow diagram, OPA policy draft, and sample audit schema. Nina can add bucket lifecycle rules and size limits. Rafael can draft DEK+global-CMK design doc and offer per-tenant CMK onboarding steps. I'll post the RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
